bus.via: Amsterdam Centraal Station to Utrecht Centraal station

trips.route_note: Frequent direct trains run from Amsterdam Centraal to Utrecht Centraal in about 30 minutes; the old centre and canals are a short walk away.
trips.why: The train takes 23 minutes, runs 22 times a day, and drops you at Utrecht Centraal near the old centre and canals.
know: Trains run frequently, so you rarely need to book ahead.
The historic centre and canals are best explored on foot once you arrive.

trips.route_note: Direct intercity trains run from Amsterdam Centraal to Den Haag Centraal in under an hour; trams reach the Binnenhof and the Mauritshuis.
trips.tour_query: The Hague day trip from Amsterdam
trips.why: The intercity train takes 33 minutes, runs 20 times a day, and reaches Den Haag Centraal, with trams to the Binnenhof and Mauritshuis.
know: Check the timetable before you travel, as services vary through the day.
Trams connect the station to the Binnenhof and Mauritshuis, so a tram is easier than walking.

bus.via: Amsterdam Central Station to Eindhoven Station

trips.route_note: Direct intercity trains run from Amsterdam Centraal to Eindhoven Centraal in about 1 hour 15 minutes, then the city centre is a short walk.
trips.why: The direct train takes 49 minutes and runs 36 times a day, with the city centre a short walk from the station.
know: Eindhoven is more modern and industrial than the historic Dutch cities, so set expectations accordingly.
Trains are frequent, but check the timetable for your return.
